family: For every integer n>=0, f_n(x)=1 iff the Hamming weight of x is congruent to 0 modulo 3; in particular f_0(empty)=1. This is the single total language L={x: sum_i x_i=0 mod 3}, with the fixed residue-scan evaluator and empty-witness NP verifier in proof.md.
theorem: In the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length n, C_B2(f_n)>=2*n-4 for every integer n>=3. Hence liminf over all integer lengths n of C_B2(f_n)/(2*n)>=1, with finite coefficient/exponent projection (2,1).
